answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the mirror is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A garden of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lotus of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, re-queued for a second panel. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
